items.title: Hackers Can Inject Malicious Code into Antivirus Processes to Create a Backdoor
items.description: A new technique enables attackers to exploit antivirus software by injecting harmful code directly into the antivirus processes. This approach makes it easier for them to evade detection and compromise the security that antivirus software is designed to provide. items.title: Microsoft Defender Vulnerabilities Allow Attackers to Bypass Authentication and Upload Malicious Files
items.description: Critical flaws uncovered in the network communication between Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (DFE) and its cloud services, allowing post-breach attackers to bypass authentication, spoof data, disclose sensitive information, and even upload malicious files to investigation packages.
